scenes.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024), processed by ESA. COG hosted by Element 84 Earth Search.
scenes.processing: RGB reference image, bilinear resampling to Web Mercator, clipped to study rectangle; JPEG. No water classification or cloud removal.
scenes.meaning: Dated optical reference only. Clouds, shadows and permanent water may be present. Not a flood boundary or current conditions.
